## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 10, 2026 - Sep 21, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Phoenix Fire Guy_, Sep 21, 2026, 1/5: "The updated app sucks. Entirely too complicated and bloated with worthless information and pictures. Accessing the guest pass is burdensome, loads terribly slow. You took a good working app and absolutely ruined it. I recommend terminating anyone involved with the updated app."
            2. _Victor Aguirre_, Sep 19, 2026, 1/5: "Before the update, the Planet Fitness app was already great as I was easily able to access my membership as well as the guest pass. Not only that, but I was able to easily log my exercise activity. Yesterday, hours after I updated the app, I went to my local PF gym and after checking in, there is a loading screen that is so slow that now I have to lose a few seconds of my time just to get access to the guest membership pass. Not to mentioned the fact that the exercise log removed some workouts."
            3. _AJey Calloway_, Jul 18, 2026, 1/5: "I'm completely over this app. I joined Planet Fitness 2 weeks ago and still have not been able to get this app to work. I tried logging in half a dozen times and it freezes. I've only been able to successfully login 1 time and even then it never gave to QR code so that I can scan everytime I enter Planet Fitness. I'm sooo over this and it's just frustrating. Even the team members that work there couldn't figure out why this is happening."
<!--/ir-theme-->
